**Finding submitted: deviation on Section 22.14 (Solicitation).**

- **Responsive language:** Only one non-solicit exists in the document (p0302, § 22.14); searches for "hire", "employ", "induce" and related terms found no other restrictive covenant, and no no-hire provision.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the mutual ban covers *all* employees of the other party (not just personnel involved in the Services), runs for the whole Term — defined at p0049 as eight years from the Commencement Date — and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. Duration over 24 months covering all Vendor personnel is walk-away territory.
- **Cure (preferred, one operation):** Section 22.14 made one-way — "M&I shall not solicit the employees of Customer during the Term of this Agreement, for any reason." This removes our restriction while preserving M&I's obligation (a Customer benefit), with no collateral rewrites; the fallback narrowing is offered in the comment.
